recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-18134; future scope work should follow later final ValueSet scope decisions or extension-pack work rather than changing the already-correct ValueSet.description definition.
issue_request: FHIR-18134 was a Published STU3 Vocabulary change request, resolved Persuasive, asking FHIR core to align ValueSet.description with the VSD Scope concept because the previous wording appeared to preclude describing the intended scope of concepts included or excluded from the expansion.
initial_application: Jira points to git commit 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249, which included GF#18134 and added the VSD Scope span-of-meanings/intended-use/limitations sentence to source/valueset/valueset-spreadsheet.xml. The 2021 source rework carried that wording into source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml.
additional_context: Later ValueSet scope issues reused the same area: FHIR-25272 added a separate trial-use ValueSet.scope structure for R5, while FHIR-34171, FHIR-35988, and FHIR-35989 later narrowed that approach by relying on ValueSet.description and removing scope.focus. Current R6 cleanup removed the separate ValueSet.scope structure, and those later issues are already represented by audit commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini lists ValueSet as active, current ValueSet.description contains the requested VSD Scope language, valueset-notes.xml gives compatible description-based VSD Focus guidance, and no current ValueSet.scope element remains to reintroduce for this seed.
